description: Cone of Cold Level 60 210 Mana Instant 10 sec cooldown Requires Mage Requires level 26 Targets in a cone in front of the caster take ( 96.2913 * 1 ) to ( 105.709 * 1 ) Frost damage and are slowed by 40% for 6 sec. The first 4 targets hit by this cone are slowed by an additional 10% for an additional 3 sec.
name: Cone of Cold
